head: unchanged PairSpecificSizeHead
condition: B; use a new detached clone of original R4 boxes as the conditioning input, no midpoint forward or M20/L5 initialization
inputs: Reuse original frozen R4 P3 ROI/support/coordinates and all naturally present B views. Preserve5116 TRAIN total/5112 present and887 VAL, order and data split; no GT-center filter.
sampling: Every original present TRAIN view once per epoch; unchanged Random(1703+epoch) and video/scale exposure
selection: ALL24 original joint-desc/real-long-short/sim-long-short/epoch ranking; gate not prefilter. Gate uses direct input B. Original M20/L5 null-selection history retained.
evaluation: TRAIN native/half and all887 VAL; four paths R4, R4+LB, R4+M20, R4+M20+LM. Report sizes/joint/RIoU/AP75/center/angle, domains/videos and accurate input B edges/migrations. LB and LM are independently trained heads, not one checkpoint with M switched off.
method: Same2480 head, reference construction/common support/pointwise decode/sort/aggregate/loss/whole-box fallback; reference and target become B-conditioned as required by removing M. No production method replacement.
stop: One24-epoch run. Identity/neutral/restore/nonfinite/resource/order failure stops, no automatic retry, continuation or search.
download: Core JSON/CSV/Markdown/SHA only, no weights/cache/prediction rows/images
